# Obsdn-Dark-Rmx

Obsdn-Dark-Rmx is a light and dark theme centered on transclusions and popover previews: inline transcluded items are displayed in full without scrollbars and marked with a thin quote line and a top-left icon. It flattens the GUI with aligned tabs and colored active pane icons, and adds styled tag pills, an experimental column file explorer and revised status bar and backlinks readability. The recorded description pairs it with the Barlow and Fira Code fonts.

![Obsdn-Dark-Rmx screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cannibalox/Obsdn-dark-rmx/HEAD/Obsdn-Dark-Rmx.png)

Flatten the GUI with aligned tabs and colored active pane icons, add styled tag pills, an experimental column file explorer, and refined status/backlinks readability; pair with Barlow and Fira Code fonts."
